findings.label: Create-function required params defaulted to None
findings.detail: Seating pipeline_name first forced workflow_path/zip_path/main_nextflow_file/etc. to '= None'; required-ness is only enforced at runtime via identifier validation and file open. Intended by the plan; no action required.

findings.label: nf-core both-supplied validation is late
findings.detail: create_nextflow_pipeline_from_nf_core_zip extracts and repacks the zip before the both-supplied ValueError fires in the terminal create call. No API call occurs first (design requirement met); only wasted file I/O. Optional: hoist the identifier check to the top of the wrapper.
